player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin wasan HighSociety (sigar mai kunnawa 2). Gudun wasan: Ana sayar da katunan daraja guda goma daya bayan daya. Yin fare: Kowane gwanjo, a asirce zabi katin kuɗi 1-11 kuma ya bayyana. • Babban tayin ya lashe katin daraja kuma ya watsar da katin kuɗin. • Ƙananan tayin ya riƙe katin kuɗin su. • Tie -> an dawo da tayin biyu kuma an sake yin katin daraja. Scoring: Bayan duk gwanjo goma, ƙara ** ragowar kuɗi + maki daraja **. Mafi * net-darajar * ya ci nasara (daidai madaidaiciya ->). ** Aiki ** tsarin aiki → ** sayi katin ɗaya kamar '[7] ko '[11].
